alertDefProperties.name: [cms-local] CMS API p95 latency > 150 ms
alertDefProperties.description: P1 · owning team: cms-platform (routing.team, Cases routed by router cms-platform to #production-alerts). p95 latency of demo-cms-api server spans (Coralogix APM span metrics, health checks excluded) is above 150 ms (2-minute rate, held for 1 minute) in cluster cms-local. Baseline is about 50 ms. Dashboard: ${DASHBOARD_URL} · Runbook: spec/components/workshop-scenarios.md, INC-1 (cms_demo repo).

metricFilter.promql: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(duration_ms_bucket{service_name="demo-cms-api", k8s_cluster_name="cms-local", span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", span_name!~"GET /(healthz|ready)"}[2m])))
